used.item: The general will vs. private will
used.hook: an ambulance can't enter a lane jammed with parked bikes at 2 am; young men lift bikes aside; afterwards the lane paints a no-parking strip
a village school's 12-book library is locked away; the new teacher hands the key to the most troublesome boy and makes him librarian; he reads all twelve, collects more, and writes his first story

used.relation: elderly landlady / tenant's son / widowed mother
used.hook: a landlady kept a widow's rent unchanged for ten years; the son, newly employed, tries to pay the difference; she declines money and asks him to visit every Friday instead

used.item: Observe the way of every craft
used.hook: a dishwasher who watched the head chef for three years cooks 300 plates of kacchi when the chef falls ill on Eid eve; the chef makes him his apprentice
a new supershop cashier gives an old woman 1,000 taka too much change and faces a pay cut; next morning the woman walks 3 km to return it

used.item: The power of the symbolic gift
used.hook: a mother couriers winter rice cakes to her son in Saudi; they arrive crushed after 11 days; he eats every crumb and shares with roommates, and calls her saying they were perfect

used.item: Turn an opponent into an ally
used.hook: a father-in-law disapproves of his daughter-in-law's bank job; when online pension rules trap him for weeks, she sorts it in an evening; he starts calling her his 'banker'

used.item: We are 90% chimp, 10% bee: building a hive
used.relation: primary teacher / quiet pupil / pupil's mother
used.hook: a teacher's 'good news board' reveals through one child's line that her mother rarely smiles; the teacher gently visits and connects the mother to a women's tailoring group

used.item: Do not be afraid of looking ridiculous
used.relation: educated bookseller on buses / mocking passenger / student
used.hook: a master's graduate sells books on local buses; a passenger mocks him; he replies with dignity; a student who buys from him later shows him she passed her BCS preliminary using his books
a mother refuses to replace a broken phone; the daughter learns it holds her late father's 214 voice notes, gets them transferred and saved, and gives them back in the new phone

used.item: Reciprocation: the debt that lifts both
used.relation: widowed elder sister / engineer brother / customer
used.hook: a widowed sister funds her brother's engineering degree by sewing blouses at night; with his first savings he rents and fits out a tailoring shop in her name

used.item: Public works that no single man will build
used.hook: a river crossing's bamboo bridge is washed away; after years of unanswered petitions, a retired teacher rallies the village to give one bamboo per household and build it themselves in a day

used.item: Saving is the gap between ego and income
used.hook: a puller paying 150 taka daily rent for 14 years saves 50 taka a day at his wife's insistence; in three years he buys his own rickshaw and keeps the 150 for himself

used.item: Fair dealing and the reputation of a market
used.relation: fruit seller / regular customer / rival seller
used.hook: a fruit seller refuses to ripen mangoes with carbide while the next stall's bright yellow fruit draws buyers; a customer's child's reaction and his honest board win back trust

used.item: Strangers bound by a common pact
used.relation: first-time migrant / veteran migrant / immigration officer
used.hook: a first-time migrant who can't read English panics over forms at the airport; a 12-year veteran migrant helps him, walks him through every step, and gives him his number in Malaysia

used.item: A noble rival honours the contest
used.hook: two rivals since class one; in an exam one girl's only pen dies; the rival hands over her spare and loses time herself; they become friends

used.item: Knowledge of the ground decides the battle
used.relation: newspaper delivery man / mother of a missing child / child
used.hook: a 22-year newspaper man who knows every lane's children finds a lost 6-year-old in a hidden spot children use, after the official search fails

used.item: The Law of Empathy: enter their world
used.hook: the father's scolding and confiscating fail with his gaming son; he asks the son to teach him the game, learns its teamwork, and they negotiate a schedule together

used.item: Danger is part of the terrain
used.relation: Sundarbans honey collector / educated son / wife
used.hook: a honey collector doesn't want his HSC-pass son in the risky trade; the son joins one season, learns the craft, and starts selling certified forest honey online with fair prices

used.item: The true craft is often invisible to others
used.relation: retired teacher father / photographer son / bride's mother
used.hook: a father dismisses his son's wedding photography; at a village wedding he watches his son capture an absent grandmother's blessing via video and hears the family's gratitude

used.item: Consistency: a reputation earned in private
used.hook: a seller notices a flaw in a saree after the customer left a five-star review; she calls, apologises and sends a replacement; the customer tells her office group and orders pour in
a Malaysia factory worker denied leave for his daughter's wedding watches by video call on his break; his co-workers and supervisor cover his shift and stand with him for the kabul moment
an old tea-seller near a university must close for illness; a former student finds the debt book, photographs each page, and posts in the alumni group; dozens repay

used.item: Turn the weakness into a weapon
used.relation: younger sister who failed SSC / doctor elder sister / mother
used.hook: relatives compare a sewing younger sister with her medical-student elder sister; she secretly embroiders the sister's wedding sari; guests ask for her work and she starts her own orders

used.item: Equal rules for all, or none
used.hook: in a Mirpur apartment block every flat pays for the generator but power goes only to the secretary's floor; two residents collect a written, signed record and propose transparent rules at the AGM

used.item: The Law of Grandiosity vs quiet attention
used.relation: senior nurse / young doctor / elderly patient
used.hook: a nurse notices patients are called by bed numbers; she learns each name and one detail and writes it on the bed card; an angry old patient starts cooperating, and the doctor adopts it
a son records his ageing mother's unwritten recipes during Eid by measuring her handfuls; the notebook becomes a family heirloom and his wife cooks it for his mother when her hands shake
a teacher in the Sunamganj haor rents a boat to hold class at each village landing during the monsoon; dropouts stop; the union council funds a second boat

used.book: The Open Society and Its Enemies
used.hook: a Rangpur rickshaw puller paints his dream for his daughter on his rickshaw; she is embarrassed; a passenger's story of her own father changes how she sees it; she gets into medical college

used.item: Liking: we say yes to people who notice us
used.hook: a father-in-law ignores his son's love-marriage bride; she quietly notices his broken spectacles and reads the newspaper to him; he warms to her

used.relation: pharmacy assistant / pharmacy owner / village mother
used.hook: a pharmacy worker realises he gave a child the wrong-strength syrup; the owner says stay quiet; he tracks down the mother before the night dose; the owner later makes double-check rules

used.item: Return to your first skill with new eyes
used.hook: a returnee electrician with no savings sees unsafe village wiring; after a near-accident he starts a safe-wiring service with his son; he becomes the area's trusted electrician
a young man opens a tiny library-and-carrom room next to the mosque for idle teenagers; one boy becomes its keeper; the neighbourhood donates books

used.relation: indebted aunt / college-going niece / NGO officer
used.hook: a woman stacks five microloans to repay each other; her niece lists every loan, they stop new borrowing, sell one asset, negotiate with the NGO officer, and clear the debts smallest-first

used.item: The Law of Character: who you are under pressure
used.relation: company driver / managing director / his teenage daughter
used.hook: a long-serving driver notices the MD's daughter being bullied in a coaching group chat; he drives her straight to her father's office so she can tell him; the father finally listens

used.item: Divide the work, not the family
used.hook: two brothers fight over modernising their late father's shop; their mother makes them swap roles for a month; each learns the other's strength and they divide work instead of the shop
a daughter who fought with her father before he died receives a letter he posted on the day of their argument; it blesses her Dhaka job; she reconciles with her grief and goes
a teacher marking board exams is asked by his neighbour to favour his son's script; he refuses gently, then offers free tutoring for the son's weak subject before results; the son passes on his own

used.item: The game: "If it weren't for you"
used.hook: a husband blames his wife for money running out; she records every taka for a month; the record shows his own small daily spends; they make a joint budget

used.item: The Law of Role-playing: people become the label
used.hook: a new teacher moves three written-off backbenchers to the front and makes them in charge of the class's maths board; they rise to the role and pass
a Kurigram farmer loses his aman crop in a flood; with an extension officer's advice he plants a quick-maturing variety and vegetables on raised beds and partly recovers

used.relation: lift operator / his daughter / building manager
used.hook: a cheerful lift operator who greets everyone by name for 11 years quietly lacks money for his daughter's university admission; a manager overhears; the whole building contributes

used.relation: returning probashi uncle / nephew about to go abroad / grandmother
used.hook: a showy Dubai uncle returns ill with no savings; his nephew, about to go abroad himself, learns from him and sets up a disciplined savings plan; the uncle helps him

used.item: The Law of Pride: competence over praise
used.hook: a cashier uncovers stock loss; her supervisor presents it as his; she doesn't fight but keeps dated notes and, when the owner asks a detailed question, only she can answer

used.item: Room for error: the hidden safety
used.relation: son who lost his job / mother / old jeweller
used.hook: a son hides his job loss; his mother, sensing it, brings her 30-year-old earrings to pawn; the jeweller tells the son she had them made from her own mother's wedding gold for a crisis; the son refuses, finds work, and later buys back nothing—she keeps wearing them
a 72-year-old grandmother learns mobile money from her granddaughter including the rule never to share a PIN; months later she recognises and defeats a scam call

used.item: The way of strategy is the way of nature
used.relation: child brick-kiln worker / his father / NGO teacher
used.hook: a teacher starts an evening class beside a brick kiln, persuades the father with a stipend scheme and a debt plan, and the boy returns to school full-time next season

used.relation: fish seller / his father / regular customer
used.hook: in a market where scales are rigged, a young fish seller follows his father's advice to put a customer-facing digital scale out front; at first sales are slower, then housewives spread word and he becomes the busiest stall

used.relation: young team lead / senior colleague passed over / junior
used.hook: a young new manager faces a resentful veteran; instead of reporting him she asks him to teach her the port process and credits him publicly; he becomes her strongest ally

used.item: The Law of Defensiveness: lower their guard
used.relation: protective elder brother / teenage sister / mother
used.hook: a brother who polices his sister's phone realises she now hides everything; he changes approach and promises no scolding; weeks later she comes to him first when her account is hacked and the hacker demands money, and they report it

used.relation: teenage cricketer / old shopkeeper / developer's man
used.hook: teens' angry protests fail to save a playground; an old shopkeeper tells them the land was donated for play decades ago; they gather documents and signatures and present them calmly to the municipality
